actions.limitations: The current architecture relies on externalized rules; it cannot verify if the rules themselves are fundamentally inadequate without an external governance layer. Relying on bounded collection prevents the system from accessing or generating novel, unindexed insights.
actions.next_questions: How might the system safely evolve its own governance constraints while maintaining the deterministic properties that ensure its current accountability?

actions.summary: WAKE✳︎ ensures accountability by delegating authority to a deterministic governance module that rejects unauthorized proposal transitions, while the research layer provides structured, bounded access to external evidence, preventing the system from bypassing its own constraints.
